CURRENT QUESTION:
rank the top 5 by how much their situp count went up since baseline, best improver first
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH situp_improvers AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(b."Child ID", e."Child ID") AS "Child ID",
    COALESCE(b."Child Name", e."Child Name") AS "Child Name",
    COALESCE(b."Gender", e."Gender") AS "Gender",
    COALESCE(b."Location", e."Location") AS "Location",
    COALESCE(b."Coach", e."Coach") AS "Coach",
    COALESCE(b."Age", e."Age") AS "Age",
    COALESCE(b."Sit Ups", 0) AS "Baseline Sit Ups",
    COALESCE(e."Sit Ups", 0) AS "Endline Sit Ups",
    (COALESCE(e."Sit Ups", 0) - COALESCE(b."Sit Ups", 0)) AS "Sit Ups Improvement"
  FROM "sportathon_baseline" b
  FULL OUTER JOIN "sportathon_endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
  WHERE b."Child ID" IS NOT NULL OR e."Child ID" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  "Child ID",
  "Child Name",
  "Gender",
  "Location",
  "Coach",
  "Age",
  "Baseline Sit Ups",
  "Endline Sit Ups",
  "Sit Ups Improvement"
FROM situp_improvers
WHERE "Sit Ups Improvement" > 0
ORDER BY "Sit Ups Improvement" DESC
LIMIT 5
```
